CustomField.description: Minimum confidence for a DRAFTED outcome whose grounding check did NOT flag it weak. A draft is only produced after the retrieval score floor (Draft_Min_Top_Score__c) and the grounding check both pass, so a non-flagged draft is by definition a strong, grounded match - it should not read as LOW just because the model self-reported cautiously on routine configuration steps. Default MEDIUM. The model can still raise to HIGH; weak-grounding still caps at LOW; NO_DRAFT_* outcomes are unaffected. Set NONE to disable the floor (revert to the raw model/retrieval clamp).
CustomField.label: Draft Drafted Confidence Floor
